_comment: Host semaphore gates (#9231). slots = the HOST_SEMAPHORE_SLOTS of the gated leg in .github/workflows/ci.yml; serving_runners = the self-hosted runners that carry the leg's label and can run it. Rule (scripts/ci/host_slots_check.py, pinned by scripts/ci/tests/test_slot_wait_outcome_9231.py): len(serving_runners) <= slots, so a job that holds a runner always finds a slot. Adding a runner with the label needs a slot first. The runner list is a declaration of the host, kept by hand to match the host; the test cannot enumerate live runners.
